cards.title: Moon Muffin Market Peep
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper card for trying an I-tell-it view in a pretend moon market; chosen narrator: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: name one make-believe market role, then invite the writer to speak as that role on paper: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: With your adult, write what your moon-market narrator says first: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: I am the ____________________, and I notice a tray of glowing muffins because...
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: Now let a friendly booth helper tell the same moment; helper name: ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close paper-scene detail your narrator can almost touch: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one far paper-scene detail near the moon arch or muffin signs: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What does the narrator hope will happen with the next muffin? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Change one sentence so it sounds more like your narrator, not you: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Point to a role picture, then copy one viewpoint sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Try one more I-tell-it sentence for a new moon snack: ____________________.

cards.title: Splash Stamp Sorter
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper card for telling a make-believe mail scene through a tiny object; object picked: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: choose a paper-world item such as a stamp, satchel, puddle label, or wobble cart: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: With your adult, write as the chosen object and tell what it notices: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: I am the ____________________, waiting at the Puddle Planet mail counter.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: A puddle clerk sees me and thinks I look like ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: What small splash, fold, or shine is beside the object? ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: What can the object see across the pretend sorting room? ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What does the object secretly want before the mail cart rolls away? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Rewrite one line so the object sounds tiny, brave, or puzzled: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Adult points to one object word; writer adds one noticing word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Tell one more paper scene from a pretend object view: ____________________.

cards.title: Buttonwood Lantern Car
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper card for widening a train-library scene from close car details to a far scene view; far focus: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: ask the writer to mark one close shelf detail and one distant pretend-scene feature: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: With your adult, start near the library train, then pull the story view toward the far end: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: Describe the lantern car from a reader helper's view: ____________________.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: Describe the same car from a tiny acorn passenger's view: ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Name a close detail on a seat, shelf, ticket, or lantern: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Name something far away in the make-believe rail hall: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What does the passenger wonder when the library train hums? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Add one far detail that changes the mood of the scene: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Adult chooses near or far; writer fills one line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Reuse near-to-far writing on another imaginary ride: ____________________.

cards.title: Crumb Map Switcheroo
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper card for retelling one bakery-map mix-up from two make-believe viewpoints; scene card name: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: choose two fictional role labels, such as button baker and map mender: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: With your adult, write the mix-up once, then write it again with a new storyteller: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: The button baker thinks the map crumb means ____________________.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: The map mender sees the same crumb and thinks ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close bakery detail beside the paper map: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one far scene detail that both storytellers notice differently: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What secret worry does the first storyteller keep tucked away? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Circle one sentence and rewrite it for the second storyteller's voice: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Choose only one sentence to switch viewpoints: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Try a new view switch with a pretend lost recipe card: ____________________.

cards.title: Teacup Weather Pane
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper card for using setting as the storyteller in a pretend teacup weather scene; setting word: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: pick one make-believe weather mood, then keep all writing on the page: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: With your adult, let the scene describe what changes when the weather shifts: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: The teacup town feels ____________________ when the cloud ribbons drift by.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: Tell the same weather moment as if the town feels the opposite: ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close teacup detail, like a saucer step or spoon bridge: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one far make-believe weather detail above the little skyline: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: If the setting could think, what would it wish for the teacup people? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Replace a plain setting word with a stronger setting lens word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Adult names a weather mood; writer adds one setting detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Use a setting lens for another tiny pretend town: ____________________.

cards.title: Pocket Park Notice Flutter
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable paper card for adding thought clues to a tiny park notice scene; hidden thought: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: choose one fictional notice-board role, then ask what that role knows but has not said: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: With your adult, write one action, then add a thought clue that changes how we read it: ____________________.
cards.firstViewPrompt: First view: A pocket-park keeper pins a tiny note that says ____________________.
cards.secondViewPrompt: Second view: A paper leaf watches the note and notices ____________________.
cards.nearDetailPrompt: Near detail: Add one close detail near the notice board, such as a round tack or ribbon tab: ____________________.
cards.farDetailPrompt: Far detail: Add one far pretend park detail that makes the notice feel important: ____________________.
cards.thoughtCluePrompt: Thought clue: What is the keeper thinking but not saying yet? ____________________.
cards.reviseViewPrompt: Revise view: Rewrite one action so the hidden thought is easier to guess: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Adult reads the action; writer adds one quiet thought word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-away line: Add one thought clue to any pretend notice scene on paper: ____________________.
